9.sql:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT ss.cds, ss.`AvgScrMath`
    FROM satscores AS ss
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT cds, `AvgScrMath`
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE `AvgScrMath` IS NOT NULL AND `AvgScrMath` > 560
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT f.`School Code`, f.`Charter Funding Type`
    FROM c_rows r
    INNER JOIN frpm f ON r.cds = f.`CDSCode`
),
t_rows AS (
    SELECT `School Code`
    FROM t_join
    WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'
),
final_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer
    FROM t_rows
)
SELECT * FROM final_count;

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT q.raceId, q.driverId, q.q2
    FROM qualifying AS q
),
filtered_laps AS (
    SELECT c.raceId, c.driverId, c.q2
    FROM c_cols c
    WHERE c.raceId = 19 AND c.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
best_lap_driver AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM filtered_laps
    ORDER BY q2 ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT d.surname
    FROM best_lap_driver b
    INNER JOIN drivers d ON b.driverId = d.driverId
)
SELECT surname FROM final_result;

WITH c_champion AS (
    SELECT 
        r.`raceId`, 
        r.`time` AS champion_time, 
        d.`forename` AS champion_forename, 
        d.`surname` AS champion_surname
    FROM results AS r
    INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON r.`driverId` = d.`driverId`
    WHERE r.`raceId` = 1156 AND r.`position` = 1
),
c_last_driver AS (
    SELECT 
        r.`raceId`, 
        r.`time` AS last_time, 
        d.`forename` AS last_forename, 
        d.`surname` AS last_surname
    FROM results AS r
    INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON r.`driverId` = d.`driverId`
    WHERE r.`raceId` = 1156 AND r.`position` = (SELECT MAX(`position`) FROM results WHERE `raceId` = 1156)
),
c_time_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, 1, INSTR(champion_time, ':') - 1) || ':' || SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) || '.' || 
        SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, '.') + 1) AS champion_time_seconds,
        CAST(SUBSTR(last_time, 1, INSTR(last_time, ':') - 1) || ':' || SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, ':') + 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) || '.' || 
        SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, '.') + 1) AS last_time_seconds
    FROM c_champion
    INNER JOIN c_last_driver ON c_champion.raceId = c_last_driver.raceId
),
c_percentage_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND((champion_time_seconds - last_time_seconds) / last_time_seconds * 100, 2) AS percentage_difference
    FROM c_time_diff
)
SELECT percentage_difference
FROM c_percentage_diff;

        r.`raceId`, 
        r.`time` AS champion_time, 
        d.`forename` AS champion_forename, 
        d.`surname` AS champion_surname
    FROM results AS r
    INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON r.`driverId` = d.`driverId`
    WHERE r.`raceId` = 1156 AND r.`position` = 1
),
c_last_driver AS (
    SELECT 
        r.`raceId`, 
        r.`time` AS last_time, 
        d.`forename` AS last_forename, 
        d.`surname` AS last_surname
    FROM results AS r
    INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON r.`driverId` = d.`driverId`
    WHERE r.`raceId` = 1156 AND r.`position` = (SELECT MAX(`position`) FROM results WHERE `raceId` = 1156)
),
c_time_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, 1, INSTR(champion_time, ':') - 1) || ':' || SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) || '.' || 
        SUBSTR(champion_time, INSTR(champion_time, '.') + 1) AS champion_time_seconds,
        CAST(SUBSTR(last_time, 1, INSTR(last_time, ':') - 1) || ':' || SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, ':') + 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) || '.' || 
        SUBSTR(last_time, INSTR(last_time, '.') + 1) AS last_time_seconds
    FROM c_champion
    INNER JOIN c_last_driver ON c_champion.raceId = c_last_driver.raceId
),
c_percentage_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND((champion_time_seconds - last_time_seconds) / last_time_seconds * 100, 2) AS percentage_difference
    FROM c_time_diff
)
SELECT percentage_difference
FROM c_percentage_diff;

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT t.`GasStationID`, t.`Amount`
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT t.`GasStationID`, SUM(t.`Amount`) AS total_amount
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    GROUP BY t.`GasStationID`
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT g.`GasStationID`, g.`ChainID`, r.total_amount
    FROM gasstations AS g
    INNER JOIN c_rows AS r ON g.`GasStationID` = r.`GasStationID`
),
t_final AS (
    SELECT `GasStationID`, MAX(`total_amount`) AS max_total
    FROM t_join
    GROUP BY `GasStationID`
),
final_answer AS (
    SELECT `GasStationID`, `total_amount`
    FROM t_join
    ORDER BY `total_amount` DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT g.`GasStationID`, g.`ChainID`, fa.`total_amount`
FROM gasstations AS g
INNER JOIN final_answer AS fa ON g.`GasStationID` = fa.`GasStationID`;

SELECT 
    y.CustomerID,
    y.Consumption
FROM 
    yearmonth y
WHERE 
    y.CustomerID IN (
        SELECT 
            t.CustomerID
        FROM 
            transactions_1k t
        WHERE 
            t.ProductID = 5
            AND (t.Price / t.Amount) > 29.00
            AND STRFTIME('%Y%m', t.Date) = '201208'
    )
ORDER BY 
    y.CustomerID;
